'''My Besties♡COMIC''' (Japanese: '''{{j|My Besties♡COMIC}}''') is a [[Pokémon 4Koma]] {{pkmn|manga}} by [[momo irone]][https://twitter.com/momo_irone/status/1842142628298551631 momo irone on X (Twitter)] (Japanese)[https://www.instagram.com/momo_irone/p/DCVSZpRyd4d/ momo irone on Instagram] (Japanese) created to promote [https://www.shibuya109.jp/blog/?pi3=340070 ＃POKÉGENIC in Shibuya ～My Besties♡～]. It was published from October 4 to November 8, 2024 on the official Japanese Pokémon Instagram account and from October 4 to November 15, 2024 on [[Poké Times]].
